value.rationale: The motivating paper finds both signs for the mean comparison at adjacent affine-plane orders, making survival-law ordering a natural stronger question. This theorem shows a universal impossibility of either stochastic domination for every existing order q>=3, determines an explicit sharp slow-tail mechanism from noncollinear triples, and pinpoints the unique integer-time crossover for the smallest nontrivial affine example. These are substantive distributional and structural facts beyond tabulated expectations; no unsupported general design result is asserted.
